universe: 346 CUT; 344 covered. H administrative roles including those without geometry.
monetary_unit: Assessment fields: observed stock CLP 2026S1. modeled_*: hypothetical annual CLP with general 2026S1 rules. net_* and scenario_q*: null while observed net components are unresolved.
count_unit: Dwellings or roles, not interchangeable observations
exclusions: No observed-tax or foregone-revenue ranking. Separate modeled ranking uses an explicit general schedule and high median assessment filter. Camp materiality is not subtracted. No camp polygons, names, folios or person records are public.
camp_sensitivity: Subtracts numeric HOGARESCEN aggregates one-for-one. Missing polygon counts stay explicit; this is not a matched estimate.
irrecoverable: INE manual viv04-viv06, occupied private dwellings with residents; descriptor only, not a camp identifier.
materiality_acceptable: Type 1,3,5,6 and wall 1-3, roof 1-4, floor 1. Excludes 25,823 material-acceptable dwellings with irrecoverable type. Not a luxury/market-value indicator.
materiality_scenarios: Fractional dwelling equivalents under transferred composition. Main and other sum to residual; neither category is matched to SII roles. Missingness alternatives concern composition only.
assessment: Observed H mean/median and share strictly above 60,030,710 CLP, 2026S1. No geometry filter. Not net tax, collection, missing-home valuation or an ecological tax probability.
modeled_tax: g(A) per observed residential assessment, then commune mean/all-role median including zeros; residual gap times each statistic. q=0/.25/.5/1 applies to both mean and median scenarios; only the mean has separate persisted q=.25/.5 columns, while the viewer derives either scenario from its q=1 value. Missing assessment blocks the commune even at q=0. See metadata.modeled_tax_model; median and mean need not be ordered.
coordinate_check: Only NULL lat/lon; does not certify valid coordinates or geometry coverage
historical: Same current crosswalk; 2024S2 contrast is separate, not an annual tax or a matched property panel
